title: Adversarial principle (France)
instrument: Code de procédure civile, art. 16 et art. 1510
description: The judge's duty to observe the adversarial principle, and its counterpart in international arbitration.

requirements.title: Points of law raised by the court
requirements.text: The judge observes and enforces the adversarial principle and may not base a decision on a point of law raised of the court's own motion without first inviting the parties' observations.
requirements.statement: I will not base a decision on a point of law I raised myself without first inviting the parties to comment.

requirements.title: International arbitration
requirements.text: Whatever the procedure, the arbitral tribunal guarantees equal treatment of the parties and respects the adversarial principle.
